project_metadata.question_text: What aspect of our customer service do you think needs the most improvement?

topics.label: Response Time Issues
examples: Takes forever to get a response from support
Waited 3 hours for a simple question to be answered
The response time is absolutely terrible, I needed help urgently but had to wait days
Why does it take so long to hear back from anyone?
Response times need serious improvement

topics.label: Staff Knowledge and Training
examples: Customer service reps don't seem to know the products well enough
I had to explain my issue multiple times because they didn't understand
Staff needs better training on technical issues
The representative couldn't answer basic questions about billing
Feels like I know more about your services than your own staff

topics.label: Communication and Clarity
examples: Agents don't explain things clearly
I got conflicting information from different representatives
Communication could be much clearer and more professional
Need better explanations of policies and procedures
Sometimes feel like we're speaking different languages

topics.label: Follow-up and Resolution
examples: Issues rarely get resolved on first contact
No follow-up after my case was supposedly 'resolved'
Had to call back multiple times for the same issue
Better follow-through on commitments made during calls
Resolution process is too complicated and takes too long

topics.label: Availability and Hours
examples: Need extended customer service hours
Would be great to have 24/7 support
Weekend availability would be helpful
Hard to reach support during business hours due to work
More availability during evenings and weekends

topics.label: Overall Satisfaction
examples: Generally satisfied but there's room for improvement
Customer service is okay but could be better
Some agents are great, others not so much
Mixed experiences depending on who I talk to
Service quality varies too much between different representatives

topics.label: Phone System and Wait Times
examples: Phone system is confusing and hard to navigate
Too many menu options before reaching a human
Long hold times are frustrating
Phone system hangs up on me frequently
Automated system doesn't understand my requests

topics.label: Online Support and Chat
examples: Live chat feature is helpful when it works
Online support portal could be more user-friendly
Chat agents are more responsive than phone support
Website FAQ section needs more detailed answers
Online ticket system is convenient but slow

topics.label: Billing and Account Issues
examples: Billing department needs better communication
Account issues take too long to resolve
Difficulty understanding charges on my bill
Billing errors happen too frequently
Need clearer billing statements and explanations

topics.label: Positive Experiences
examples: Some representatives are extremely helpful and knowledgeable
When I reach the right person, issues get resolved quickly
Appreciate the patience of certain customer service agents
Recent improvements in service quality are noticeable
Had a great experience with the technical support team

topics.label: Technical Support Specific
examples: Technical support needs more specialized knowledge
Tech issues require multiple escalations to resolve
Better tools for technical troubleshooting needed
Technical support team is helpful but needs more resources
Complex technical issues take too long to diagnose

topics.label: Escalation Process
examples: Escalation process is unclear and confusing
Takes too long to reach a supervisor when needed
Need clearer escalation procedures for complex issues
Supervisors are more helpful but hard to reach
Escalation should happen sooner for urgent issues

topics.label: Self-Service Options
examples: More self-service options would be helpful
Online portal is useful but could be expanded
Better documentation for common issues
Self-service tools work well for basic tasks
Video tutorials would be a great addition

topics.label: Multilingual Support
examples: Need better language support options
Translation quality could be improved
More languages available would be helpful
Language barrier makes issues harder to resolve
Appreciate the multilingual options but need expansion

topics.label: Proactive Communication
examples: Would appreciate proactive updates on service issues
Better notification of outages and maintenance
Proactive follow-up after issue resolution
More communication about account changes
Early warning about policy changes would be helpful

topics.label: Mobile App Support
examples: Mobile app support features need improvement
In-app chat function doesn't work well
Mobile support is limited compared to web
App interface for support requests could be better
Mobile experience for customer service is lacking
